title: Universal Orlando to open Epic Universal to annual passes
summary:
By Robert Niles: It's happening. Universal Orlando soon will open its new Epic Universe theme park to annual passholders.

Don't fire up the car and head over just yet, though. Current Universal Orlando Annual Pass holders will need to upgrade the passes in order to visit Epic Universe. Then, once they do so, they will need to make a reservation to use their upgraded UOAP to visit the park.

That's right. Park reservations are back on the east coast. Disneyland Magic Key holders have been doing pass reservations for years in California. Universal Orlando Annual Passholders soon will be joining them, at least when they want to visit Epic. Reservations will not be required at the other parks.

Oh, and by the way, they're not going to be "Annual Passholders" at Universal Orlando anymore. When Universal introduces its new annual pass program starting next month, the resort will start calling the people who buy those passes "Pass Members."

In addition, the names of Universal's pass tiers will be changing:

  • Premier will become Platinum,
  • Preferred will become Gold,
  • Power will become Silver,
  • Seasonal will become Bronze.

This brings Orlando in line with the vocabulary now used at Universal Studios Hollywood. Consider this the policy to be named later in the deal a few years back that forced USH to start calling its Halloween Horror Nights mazes "houses" to match Orlando.

If that's not enough change for you, yep, there's more. Universal Orlando will phasing out plastic-card annual passes, switching to digital passes in the Universal Orlando app. Let's see y'all start wearing your phones on those lanyards now.

The Epic Universe upgrades will be available to current eligible UOAP "members" starting next month. The Florida resident price for the upgrade will range from $125 to $410, depending upon your current pass level. Pass members not in their upgrade window will get prorated prices for the upgrade, depending upon pass level and how much time remains on their pass.

Once they upgrade, pass members may make reservations to visit Epic starting January 4, 2027. Pass members may hold up to two reservations at a time. Reservation availability will be limited, as Universal looks to continue limiting access to Epic Universe.

The reservation requirement seems to me a fair trade-off to allow pass members access to the park while Universal tries to protect Epic's day ticket buyers from being stuck in endless queues behind annual passholders.

The upgrade opportunity will roll out in phases by pass level, starting next month. All current passholders will have the opportunity to upgrade (and make reservations) before the new Epic Universe-inclusive annual passes go on sale to the public later in December. Epic Universe-inclusive Passes will start at $449.99, for Florida residents.

Stay tuned for additional details, including program start dates and other price points. To keep up with more theme park news, please sign up for Theme Park Insider's free weekly newsletter.

title: United Parks offers fresh looks at what's next in 2027
summary:
By Robert Niles: United Parks threw a bit of a coming-out party at the IAAPA Expo today for its United Parks Creative team. The company has launched new social media channels for its attraction design shop, which was known as Deep Blue Creative back when the company was called SeaWorld Parks and Entertainment.

I posted earlier about the company's new launched water coaster coming to Busch Gardens Tampa Bay next summer: Busch Gardens is getting a new water coaster for 2027. United Parks today also offered fresh looks at two previously announced attractions coming to its parks.

SEAQuest: Legends of the Deep

First announced in 2025 for debut this year, then delayed, this Vekoma suspended dark ride now is scheduled to open next year at SeaWorld Orlando.

United Parks Creative today shared a couple of pieces of concept art for the ride, which will take riders on a simulated undersea adventure on free swinging ride vehicles that can rotate 360 degrees.


Images courtesy United Parks


Finding treasure on SEAQuest: Legends of the Deep

Return to Corkscrew Hill

This Brogent Technologies motion ride will open next year at Busch Gardens Williamsburg. The show calls back to the Corkscrew Hill motion theater show that ran at the park from 2001 to 2010.

Here's the set-up from United Parks Creative: "Guests are invited to McLarney Castle for an exhibition on Irish myths and folklore. The witch Moll lures them into an off-limits gallery, where an enchanted painting transports them into the world of Corkscrew Hill. Friendly fairies explain that the only way home is through another enchanted painting in Moll�s tower."


The witch Moll. Images courtesy United Parks


Inside the queue

Stay tuned for specific opening dates. For more theme park news, please sign up for Theme Park Insider's free weekly newsletter.

title: Busch Gardens is getting a new water coaster for 2027, too
summary:
By Robert Niles: Did you like yesterday's Mack Rides water coaster announcement at the IAAPA Expo in Orlando?

If you did, here's treat for you - a second Mack Rides water coaster announcement, today!

One day after Mack Rides and Holiday World revealed one of the ride vehicles for the Cannonball! water coaster coming next year to the Santa Claus, Indiana theme park, United Parks announced that it will be bringing a water coaster to Busch Gardens Tampa Bay in 2027.

Simbi Rush will be the first launched water coaster in North America and the fastest water coaster on the continent, the park said in its announcement. (I am guessing that means Mack Rides water coasters, and that we're not counting the Intamin launched flume ride at SeaWorld San Antonio here.)

Simbi Rush will feature a top speed 40 mph with two launches and a story inspired by Central African folklore about water guardian spirits. The ride is going in on the site of the former Stanley Falls Flume and will open next summer. Here is the reveal video from the park.

What's the over/under on the percentage of fans who end up calling this Simba Rush, after The Lion King protagonist?

title: Disneyland sets dates, themes for 2027 After Dark events
summary:
By Robert Niles: Disneyland is adding a new theme to its Disneyland After Dark line-up for 2027.

That new theme is "Disneylandia Nite," a celebration of Hispanic and Latin culture. Or, more to the point, it will be Disneyland's celebration of The Walt Disney Company's celebration of Hispanic and Latin cultures through IP such as Coco and Encanto.

The dates for 2027's Disneylandia Nite will be Sunday, April 11, Tuesday, April 13, and Thursday, April 15.

Disneyland After Dark is a hard-ticket, after-hours event held on select Sunday, Tuesday and Thursday nights at the park during the first six months of the year. Admission starts at 6pm, during regular park hours, and continues through 9pm to 1am, when the park is open only to party-goers. Unlimited Disney PhotoPass downloads are included with the party, which offer plenty of character meets and other photo ops in addition to special entertainment and food and merchandise.

The year's first event will be the return of Sweethearts' Nite, which adds a 10th evening this year. The event will run Sunday, Tuesday and Thursday night from January 24 through February 16.

The only exception to that schedule will be Sunday, February 14 - the actual Valentine's Day - which will not have a Sweethearts' Nite event. That might be due to the fact that Sunday, February 14 is Super Bowl Sunday this year, and Disney's ABC and ESPN have the rights to the NFL's championship game this time. Gotta stay home and watch that, right?

Of course, Disney also is hoping that many NFL fans will choose to buy their way out of "skipping Valentine's Day for the Super Bowl" jail by getting a couple of tickets to the Disneyland After Dark Sweethearts' Nite on another evening.

Those tickets will go on sale no earlier than 9am Pacific Time on Thursday, December 10. A presale for Magic Key holders will start on December 8.

In addition to these two events, Disneyland After Dark will welcome back Star Wars Nite on April 27 and 29 and May 4 and 6. Pride Nite will return on Thursday, June 17. Tickets and details for the other Disneyland After Dark events will be released later.

title: Here are the winners of the 2027 Thea Awards
summary:
By Robert Niles: The Themed Entertainment Association last night in Orlando announced the winners of its 33rd annual Thea Awards.

The TEA is the industry's leading association of attraction designers, including many members from Walt Disney Imagineering, Universal Creative and the many other independent shops and firms that support the creation of themed entertainment in parks, museums, retail, zoos, and brand experiences around the world.

The Thea Awards are unusual in that honorees do not compete in fixed categories. Instead, TEA judges choose to honor those projects that they believe have met the standard and excellence for the awards.

The awards will be presented in Orlando next spring. The 2027 Thea Award winners are:

  • Cruise Experience: Disney Adventure, Disney Cruise Line
  • Cultural Live Spectacular: The Great Qin, Xi�an, China
  • Cultural Museum Experience: Guangdong�Macao Traditional Chinese Medicine Cultural Experience Center, Zhuhai, China
  • Extended Reality Attraction, Limited Budget: Sasquatch Mountain, Miner�s Landing, Pier 57, Seattle
  • Heritage Museum: Lost Shtetl Museum, �eduva, Lithuania
  • Immersive Media Attraction: Oceano Odyssey � Mission Pelagos, Monaco
  • Live Interactive Game Experience: The Traitors: Live Experience, London
  • Live Entertainment & Dining Experience: Cirque du Soleil: Ludo, VidantaWorld, Es Vallarta - Nuevo Nayarit, Mexico
  • Reimagined Attraction: Rock �n� Roller Coaster Starring The Muppets: Disney�s Hollywood Studios
  • Seasonal Event: Universal Fan Fest Nights, Universal Studios Hollywood
  • Technical Innovation: AquaStage, Aquatique Show & Dronisos, Strasbourg, France
  • Technical Innovation: Aqua Drones, CRYSTAL, Paris
  • Theatrical Experience: Masquerade, New York City
  • Water Park: Aquarabia, Qiddiya City, Saudi Arabia
  • Wildlife and Adventure Park: Rainforest Wild Adventure, Mandai Wildlife Reserve, Singapore

Walt Disney World's Space Mountain won the 2027 Thea Classic Award.

In addition to the Thea Awards, the TEA honored the following projects with TEA Spotlight Awards.

  • Brand Experience: Netflix House, King of Prussia, Pennsylvania and Dallas
  • Family Attraction: Galacticoaster, Legoland Florida Resort and Legoland California Resort
  • Family Museum Experience, Limited Budget: FAMily Discovery Center at First Americans Museum, Oklahoma City
  • Immersive Attraction: Niagara Takes Flight, Niagara Falls, Ontario, Canada
  • Immersive Literary Experience: The Rabbit hOle, Kansas City, Missouri

Finally, the TEA honored former Imagineer Craig Russell with The Buzz Price Thea Award for a Lifetime of Outstanding Achievement. TEA also honored the late Dolly Parton with its Thea Catalyst Award.

title: Disney World offers new ticket deal for Disney Plus subscribers
summary:
By Robert Niles: The Disney discounting continues.

The Walt Disney World Resort is offering another early-season 2027 discount on theme park tickets. Announced today, the deal is available to Disney+ subscribers, via the Disney+ Perks page.

The ticket is a three-day, three-park ticket. But the Walt Disney World Resort has four theme parks, I can hear you say. Correct. This deal does not include admission to the Magic Kingdom, the most popular of Disney's theme parks. Count this as yet another way that Disney is using discounts and deals to even out attendance at its parks.

The ticket starts at $325 plus tax and is valid for start dates from January 11 to May 21, 2027. There is a five-day fuse on the ticket, meaning that you must complete your three days within five days of your first use of the ticket. And you have to go one of each of the three "other" Disney parks on your three days - EPCOT, Disney's Hollywood Studios and Disney's Animal Kingdom. No doubling up to use the ticket for multiple days at one park, and no Park Hopping.

Disney earlier this week introduced a free-ticket deal for Disney Cruise Line passengers who sail from Florida parks on select cruises from April through September, as WDW looks to boost attendance during its hot summer months. To keep up with all the latest deals and discounts from Disney, please contact our travel agent or sign up for Theme Park Insider's free weekly newsletter.

title: IAAPA opens record Expo show floor in Orlando
summary:
By Robert Niles: IAAPA opened the show floor for its largest Expo in history in Orlando this morning. More than 1,350 exhibiting companies are filling a record 630,000 square feet of exhibit space across the Orange County Convention Center's two buildings for this year's event. It's the first time that IAAPA has used both the North/South and West Buildings for its IAAPA Expo.

The big news off the show floor today came with reveals of new coaster trains for several 2027 attractions across the U.S. Six Flags Magic Mountain and Vekoma unveiled the train for the first-ever Thrill Glider coaster, which debuts at the California park next year.


Photo courtesy Six Flags

Kentucky Kingdom and The Gravity Group showed off the train for Midnight Showdown, the largest indoor wooden roller coaster in the world, which opens next year at the Louisville theme park - just down the road from Kentucky Derby home Churchill Downs.


Photo courtesy Herschend and The Gravity Group

Utah's Lagoon theme park has partnered Intamin for the first U.S. installation of Intamin's Hot Racer model, which opens as J3 Grand Prix next year. Here's their new showcase video:

In other reveals, we have a first look at a train from Miner�s Mountain Express at Silver Dollar City, from Mack Rides.

Also from Mack Rides is the Cannonball! water coaster ride vehicle for Holiday World.


Photo courtesy Holiday World & Splashin' Safari

Lost Island Theme Park showed off a car for its new Forbidden Lair, the first Wild Moose coaster from Rocky Mountain Construction.

Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex announced Aero Test Lab, an "immersive new ride experience" featuring Maurer�s Spike Coaster ride system.

Legoland Florida also announced a new Master Model Builder Studio opening in 2027, taking over the former Heartlake Hall. The studio will allow park visitors to watch Legoland's Master Model Builders at work, and, at times, meet them, ask questions and get a closer look at upcoming Lego models.

The 2026 IAAPA Expo continues through Friday.
